name: ai-work-intake
description: AI-Assisted Work Intake System - monorepo (NestJS backend + React/Vite frontend). Each app under apps/ is self-contained with its own package.json, node_modules, and .env.

scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/backend && npm run build --prefix apps/frontend
